findings.summary: The collective turn, which is the point of the section, was reduced to a sentence about comparing perceptions.

evidence.baseline: if we begin to take responsibility for the four windows collectively, intending, attending, imagining, and sensing in concert rather than at cross-purposes, we begin to construct a shared world rather than a million private ones, and to discover, in that shared making, how human beings might interact with far greater coherence, far greater coordination, and far greater capacity than our present fragmentation allows
evidence.shipped: When people compare perception rather than assume a single private view is complete, they may build a more trustworthy shared account.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.4 applied to the triad of far greater.
findings.diagnosis: A million private ones and our present fragmentation are the two concrete terms in the section and both went. The triad is repetitive and the repair is to drop the repeated far greater, not the three nouns, since coherence, coordination, and capacity are three different claims. What survives describes an epistemic practice. The baseline describes building a world together, which is the sentence Part IV then acts on.

findings.summary: The section’s closing statement of what the volume is for was cut.

evidence.baseline: The work of this volume is, in the end, the work of learning to build the world together, on purpose.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.23, meta claims about the text.
findings.diagnosis: This is the volume’s thesis in one line, placed at the end of Part III where the internal technologies have just been defined and before Part IV applies them at scale. Removing it leaves the transition to coordination unmotivated.

debtImpact.note: According to Taoist philosophy is not restored. The unverified attribution marker is kept and moved to the end of the section so the argument lands before the caveat.

The construction claim, the unconscious default, the collective turn, a million private ones, present fragmentation, and the closing statement of the volume’s work.

The Taoist attribution marker, relocated to the end. The prior pass line that a coherent civilization cannot be installed as software, which is substituted prose that carries the Part III summary well.
